abstract: In the department of Obstetrics and Gynecology of Kurume University, I, 355 cases of ovarian neoplasma were treated from 1960 to 1979, and of these cases 336 belonged to the semimalignant group and the most malignant group of the Japanese Ovarian Committee (J.O.C.). These groups are substantially grouped together into the category of malignant tumor by J.O.C., but their 5-year survival rates are considerably different, i.e., 67.6% for the semimalignant group and 30.8% for the most malignant group. Particularly, since tumors of the semimalignant group often occur in young women who must retain their generative functions, they must be treated differentially from the group of adenocarcinoma which appears frequently in rather aged patients. The present paper describes the clinical management of dysgerminoma, the incidence of which is high in the semimalignant group, and common epithelial carcinoma, the incidence of which is high in the most malignant group.
abstract_ja: 久留米大学産婦人科において、1960年から1979年までに卵巣腫瘍355例を治療した。このうち336例は日本卵巣腫瘍研究会（J.O.C.）の準悪性群と最悪性群に属した。これらの群は、J.O.C.により悪性腫瘍として大きくまとめられているが、5年生存率は大きく異なる。準悪性群は67.6%、最悪性群は30.8%であった。準悪性群の腫瘍は生殖機能を保持すべき若年女性に多く発生するため、高齢患者に多く発生する腺癌群とは区別して治療しなければならない。本論文は、準悪性群で発生頻度が高いディスジャーミノーマと、最悪性群で発生頻度が高い一般上皮性癌の臨床管理を述べる。
